svg.title: Features: 3D Earth, grounded AI assistant, voice, dashboard and charts, radar and history, alerts and push, accounts, installable PWA.
svg.desc: Interactive 3D Earth: Rotate, zoom and click anywhere. Raycasting turns a click into real coordinates, with clouds, day and night and city beacons. Grounded AI assistant: Answers use live, timestamped weather for your place, not the model’s memory. Weather Q&A, trip planner and city compare. Voice in, voice out: Browser speech recognition and synthesis, with permission handling, error states and text clean-up for natural playback. Dashboard and charts: Current conditions, hourly and 7-day forecast, multi-city overview, and hand-built SVG charts for temperature, rain and wind. Radar and history: Live RainViewer radar on a 2D map, plus ERA5 reanalysis history for any point on Earth, with provenance notes. Alerts and push: Six alert rule types with de-duplication and cooldowns, an in-app notification center and standards-based Web Push. Accounts and saved places: Supabase auth with row-level security, saved locations, unit preferences and synced AI conversations. Installable PWA: Manifest, service worker and offline page, with stale data clearly labelled instead of passed off as live.
